brief: onboarding modal that appears on first login. Centered overlay with a backdrop. Inside: a title ('Welcome — let's set up your workspace'), a two-line description, two CTAs (primary: 'Get started'; secondary: 'Skip for now'), and a close X icon in the top-right corner. The modal has rounded corners, a subtle shadow, and uses the project's surface tokens. Width caps at ~480px on desktop, full-width with margin on mobile.
